description: This file implements a saturation-aware, priority-based dynamic rate limiter for a machine learning API proxy. It manages rate limits at both model and priority levels using a multi-phase approach to prevent partial counter increments and ensure Fair resource allocation. It interacts with Redis-based tracking via v3 limiter components, performs saturation checks, and dynamically adjusts rate limiting behavior based on current system saturation and user priorities.
